beaches.name: Armeos (Agia Pakou)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is the norm across this small beach behind Galissas. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1997 to 2017 and says the beach is marked as nudist on local tourist maps; a 2017 review and the Cyclades chamber tourism portal agree. No authority designation is documented.

beaches.name: Delfini
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the southern (left) end of the beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2003 to 2024 and a 2018 review agrees; the northern end has a taverna and sunbeds. Reports from 2016 and 2017 describe a neighbouring house owner calling the police; later reports say nude use continues.
